# Reconstructions Outline

## How do contemporary audiences and the broader dance community assess authenticity of the reconstructions of nineteenth century classics?

* Joffrey Ballet reconstructions of early twentieth century ballets at the Ballet Russe;
  * Vaslav Nijinsky's *Le Sacre du Printemps* to Stravinsky score in 1913; recorded for Dance in America: can be seen in the film Nijinsky (1980); John J. O'Connor, "TV: Nureyev-Joffrey Ballet Tribute to Nijinsky," *New York Times*, March 9, 1981.

* Le Sacre du Printemps:
  * Composed by Igor Stravinsky
  * Choreographed by Vaslav Nijinsky
  * Conception by Sergei Diaghilev in 1909
